name: EVA-1: Landing site to Wildcat Ridge
science_goal: Sample delta sediments and carbonates that may preserve signs of ancient life

waypoints.name: Habitat airlock
waypoints.note: Octavia E. Butler landing site (Perseverance, 18 Feb 2021)

waypoints.name: Sid
waypoints.task: Inspect the igneous rock Perseverance cored. Samples 8 and 9, sols 371 and 377.
waypoints.source: NASA Perseverance sample list + rover position on the sealing sol (NASA/JPL MMGIS M20_waypoints)

waypoints.name: Brac
waypoints.task: Core the olivine-rich rock of Seitah. Samples 4 and 5, sols 262 and 271.
waypoints.source: NASA Perseverance sample list + rover position on the sealing sol (NASA/JPL MMGIS M20_waypoints)

waypoints.name: Issole
waypoints.task: Collect a core from the Issole outcrop. Samples 6 and 7, sols 298 and 337.
waypoints.source: NASA Perseverance sample list + rover position on the sealing sol (NASA/JPL MMGIS M20_waypoints)

waypoints.name: Wildcat Ridge
waypoints.task: Sample the delta mudstone, best place for signs of ancient life. Samples 12 and 13; Skinner Ridge samples 10 and 11 are 35 meters away.
waypoints.source: NASA Perseverance sample list + rover position on the sealing sol (NASA/JPL MMGIS M20_waypoints)
